xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2984: Assisted Node-24 install for the open-knowledge viewer (version-manager aware, never touches default node)

plan.title: Assisted Node-24 install for the open-knowledge viewer (version-manager aware, never touches default node)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: pan knowledge open and the dashboard Knowledge page hard-fail on machines whose ambient Node is <24 (`open-knowledge requires Node 24+; found v22.22.0`). @inkeep/open-knowledge needs Node >=24 for its subprocess only, while Overdeck requires >=22.16 and the dashboard is pinned to Node 22 — so 'upgrade your Node' is a dead end. A Node 24 runtime often already exists under a version manager; the installer never looks.
narratives.Proposal: Replace the hard failure with a detection ladder in ensureOpenKnowledge(): (1) working ok binary (PATH plus explicit ~/.local/bin/ok probe), (2) OVERDECK_OPEN_KNOWLEDGE_NODE override, (3) version manager (nvm/fnm/volta/mise/asdf) with an existing 24+ runtime — install the package under it and write a pinned shim to ~/.local/bin/ok, (4) manager without 24 — consent-gated install of Node 24 through their manager, (5) no manager — consent-gated nvm bootstrap or manual instructions. The resolved command threads through every ok invocation; CLI and dashboard share one setup-plan resolver; the dashboard error state becomes a 'Set up the viewer' assisted flow. Full spec: .pan/drafts/PAN-2984.md (promoted to drafts/pan-2984.md on overdeck-state).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Windows support for the shim or detection ladder (POSIX sh only)
- Changing the dashboard's Node 22 pin, Overdeck's engines range, or the user's ambient/default Node
- Eager installation from pan install, dashboard boot, or any unattended path
- Importing, linking, or bundling open-knowledge code (GPL boundary stays)
- Auto-updating an already-working ok installation
- Homebrew/apt/system package managers as Node sources

autoDecisions.summary: Thread the resolved ok command (absolute shim path) through status/start/stop via okCommand?: string defaulting to 'ok', instead of relying on PATH.
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard server's PATH cannot be assumed to include ~/.local/bin; defaulting to 'ok' keeps every existing caller and test working unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Put detection/enumeration/shim-writing in a new src/lib/installers/node-runtime.ts module; keep ladder orchestration in open-knowledge.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps open-knowledge.ts focused and gives the version-manager logic its own injectable seams and test file, matching the installer-module convention.

autoDecisions.summary: Use non-default-changing install commands per manager: volta fetch node@24, nvm install in a sourced subshell, fnm/mise/asdf plain installs.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-1 forbids touching the default Node; volta install would change it, volta fetch does not.

autoDecisions.summary: Install the package under the pinned runtime by spawning its npm with PATH prepended by the runtime bin dir; resolve the entry script via realpath of the installed bin symlink.
autoDecisions.rationale: Prevents the npm shebang from resolving ambient Node 22 and keeps all writes inside the runtime tree; realpath is robust against the package moving dist/cli.mjs.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate rungs 4-5 behind a typed OpenKnowledgeSetupRequiredError carrying the setup plan; rungs 2-3 run under the existing autoInstall consent.
autoDecisions.rationale: Rungs 2-3 download nothing new beyond the npm package (already consented today); downloading a Node runtime or installing nvm is a bigger action the user must see and approve first.

autoDecisions.summary: No new dashboard endpoints: status gains a setupPlan field, and the existing POST /api/knowledge-viewer/install executes the full ladder after the frontend shows the plan.
autoDecisions.rationale: The install button is already the explicit consent affordance; reusing it keeps the API surface and auth posture unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Shim ownership is a marker comment; foreign ~/.local/bin/ok files are never overwritten.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's hand-written shim predates the marker and must keep working; clobbering user files is unrecoverable.
The shim is POSIX sh and Overdeck targets Linux/macOS; no Windows support exists in the surrounding surfaces.

items.title: node-runtime.ts: version-manager detection and Node 24 runtime resolution

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Creates a brand-new module and test file no other wave-0 item touches; nothing existing imports it yet.

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/installers/node-runtime.ts exporting resolveNode24Runtime({ env, homedir, listDir, runCommand }) implementing the PRD's manager table: detect nvm ($NVM_DIR, ~/.nvm, ~/.config/nvm), fnm, volta, mise, asdf by detection-root existence (env var first); enumerate runtime node binaries by the per-manager globs; parse versions from path segments; validate the chosen binary once with --version; honor OVERDECK_OPEN_KNOWLEDGE_NODE as a validated override that errors loudly when invalid. Return { kind: 'runtime', nodePath, source } | { kind: 'manager-without-24', manager } | { kind: 'none' }. All seams injectable (NFR-1). See .pan/drafts/PAN-2984.md §'Version-manager table'.

items.title: Given a fake nvm tree with v22.22.0 and v24.17.0, resolveNode24Runtime returns the v24 bin/node path with source 'nvm'
Given manager roots containing only <24 runtimes, it returns { kind: 'manager-without-24' } naming the manager; with no roots it returns { kind: 'none' }
Given OVERDECK_OPEN_KNOWLEDGE_NODE pointing at a fake node reporting v24, it returns that path with source 'override' without scanning managers
Given an override whose --version validation fails, it rejects with an error message containing 'OVERDECK_OPEN_KNOWLEDGE_NODE'

Given multiple >=24 runtimes, resolveNode24Runtime returns the highest version's bin/node selected by path-segment parsing, and the injected runCommand records a --version call only for that selected binary
node-runtime.ts: writeOkShim with ownership marker and foreign-file protection

narrative.Action: Add writeOkShim({ nodePath, entryScript, shimPath }) and readShimOwnership(shimPath) -> 'overdeck' | 'foreign' | 'absent' to node-runtime.ts. The shim is the PRD's POSIX sh template with the 'overdeck-managed shim' marker line, written mode 0755 with mkdir -p on the parent (default shim path ~/.local/bin/ok). Overwriting is allowed only when ownership is 'overdeck' or 'absent'; a 'foreign' file rejects with an error naming the path and asking the user to delete or fix it (H3). See .pan/drafts/PAN-2984.md §'Shim contract'.

items.title: writeOkShim creates an executable (0755) file whose content contains the marker line and exec "<nodePath>" "<entryScript>" "$@"
Called with an existing file lacking the marker, writeOkShim rejects naming the path and preserves the file content byte-for-byte
Called with an existing overdeck-owned shim, writeOkShim produces an updated shim whose exec line contains the new node and entry paths
readShimOwnership returns 'absent' for a missing file, 'overdeck' for a marked shim, 'foreign' otherwise
ensureOpenKnowledge: detection ladder, setup-plan resolver, and typed setup-required error

expected_outputs: open-knowledge.test.ts passes with new ladder cases
metadata.acJustification: Six ACs: the ladder has five distinct rung behaviors plus the repo fake-timer rule; collapsing them would hide independently verifiable outcomes.

narrative.Action: Rework ensureOpenKnowledge (src/lib/installers/open-knowledge.ts:88-119): rung 1 probes 'ok' on PATH and then ~/.local/bin/ok by absolute path; export resolveOpenKnowledgeSetupPlan() and executeOpenKnowledgeSetupPlan() plus the OpenKnowledgeSetupPlan union and OpenKnowledgeSetupRequiredError from the PRD. With autoInstall: true, plans of kind 'install-under-runtime' (rungs 2-3) execute inline: spawn <runtimeBin>/npm install -g @inkeep/open-knowledge with env PATH prepended by <runtimeBin> (H2/D4), resolve entryScript = realpath(<runtimePrefix>/bin/ok), write the shim via ok-shim-writer, health-check via the shim path, and return { status: 'installed', command: <shim path> }. Plans 'install-node-via-manager'/'install-nvm' (rungs 4-5) throw OpenKnowledgeSetupRequiredError carrying the plan with plain-English steps (exact commands from the PRD manager table; volta fetch, nvm sourced subshell). autoInstall: false keeps today's manual-command error verbatim. EnsureOpenKnowledgeResult.command widens to string. Keep injectable runCommand/sleep seams; existing installationError stays as terminal fallback (D9). All retry tests use fake timers (H6).

items.title: With a fake runtime resolved, ensureOpenKnowledge({autoInstall:true}) spawns npm with PATH prefixed by the runtime bin dir, writes the shim, and resolves { command: <shim path> }
With only a manager-without-24, it rejects with OpenKnowledgeSetupRequiredError whose plan.kind is 'install-node-via-manager' and whose installCommand for volta equals 'volta fetch node@24'
With no version manager, it rejects with a plan of kind 'install-nvm' whose steps include the manual npm install one-liner
Rung 1 returns command '~/.local/bin/ok' (absolute) when the bare 'ok' probe fails but the shim path probe succeeds
With autoInstall: false and no working ok, it rejects with the existing manual-install message and never invokes the resolver (rungs 2-5 skipped)
The post-install health-polling test advances time via vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync under fake timers and exits without real setTimeout delays

pan knowledge open: consent prompt for rung 4/5 setup plans

expected_outputs: knowledge.test.ts passes with the new prompt cases

narrative.Action: In knowledgeOpenCommand (src/cli/commands/knowledge.ts:136-160), catch OpenKnowledgeSetupRequiredError from ensure. On a TTY (process.stdin.isTTY), print each plan step as its own line, prompt 'Proceed? [y/N]' via readline/promises createInterface (pattern: src/cli/commands/start.ts), and on yes run executeOpenKnowledgeSetupPlan(plan) then re-run ensure and continue; on no, print the plan's manual command and exit without error. On non-TTY stdin, rethrow an error whose message contains the steps and manual command (no hanging prompt). Inject the prompt and executor via KnowledgeOpenDependencies for tests. --no-install (options.install === false) keeps passing autoInstall: false and never reaches the prompt.

items.title: On TTY with an install-node-via-manager plan, the CLI prints the plan steps and prompts; answering y executes the plan and retries ensure to completion
Answering n exits printing the manual command without invoking the executor
With non-TTY stdin the command rejects with a message containing the plan steps and never opens a readline interface
With --no-install and no working ok, the command rejects with the manual-install message, renders no prompt, and never executes a setup plan
Dashboard server: setupPlan in status, full ladder in install

narrative.Action: Service (src/dashboard/server/services/knowledge-viewer.ts): when ensure({autoInstall:false}) fails, call the injected resolveOpenKnowledgeSetupPlan and include setupPlan: { kind, steps } in KnowledgeViewerStatus (installed stays false). Routes (src/dashboard/server/routes/knowledge-viewer.ts:86-90): the install handler runs ensure({autoInstall:true}); on OpenKnowledgeSetupRequiredError it runs executeOpenKnowledgeSetupPlan(plan) then re-runs ensure, then invalidates the installation cache and returns fresh status. No new routes; auth/origin handling unchanged. If existing test files for these modules live at different paths, extend those instead of creating parallel ones.
